mapper.select: SELECT id, transaction_reference, account_id, transaction_type, amount, balance_after, description, timestamp FROM transactions WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, transaction_reference, account_id, transaction_type, amount, balance_after, description, timestamp FROM transactions WHERE transaction_reference = #{reference}
SELECT id, transaction_reference, account_id, transaction_type, amount, balance_after, description, timestamp FROM transactions WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY timestamp DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transactions (transaction_reference, account_id, transaction_type, amount, balance_after, description) VALUES (#{transactionReference}, #{accountId}, #{transactionType}, #{amount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{description})
